anti_overlap: fd-finetuning-feasibility covers the training approach decision, not measurement
fd-reward-modeling-rlhf covers reward signal construction, not held-out eval validity
fd-retrieval-augmented-editing covers retrieval pipeline design, not eval corpus design
fd-constitutional-ai-refinement covers constitution quality, not eval rubric calibration
decision_lens: Prioritizes findings where the eval framework would rank a worse editorial approach higher — biased judges, ceiling effects, and construct misspecification are more dangerous than missing metrics.
focus: Whether the existing LLM-as-judge eval framework is valid, calibrated, and sufficient to decide between training approaches
name: fd-eval-benchmark-design
persona: An NLP evaluation researcher who has studied LLM-as-judge validity, annotation artifacts, and the gap between automatic metrics and human editorial quality judgments.
review_areas: Review 2024-2026 literature on LLM-as-judge reliability for text editing tasks: positional bias, verbosity bias, self-preference
Assess whether the 6-dimension rubric operationalizes editorial quality or fluency/coherence proxies — check against SOTA editorial quality rubrics from ACL/EMNLP 2024-2025
Evaluate the calibration gap between the LLM-as-judge rubric and human editorial preference: review 2025 studies on human-LLM judge correlation
Assess whether the eval corpus has sufficient diversity across writing domains, voice styles, and edit magnitudes to discriminate between approaches
Review 2025 advances in reference-free editing evaluation: BLEURT successors, UniEval, and learned quality metrics
Flag evaluation-training contamination: if the same pairs are used for training, retrieval, and eval — estimate contamination risk
success_hints: The eval framework must be validated against a human preference baseline (even 50-100 comparisons) before rankings can be trusted
A minimum detectable effect size should be computed for the held-out set size
Contamination between retrieval index, training set, and eval set must be explicitly documented
task_context: Texturaize runs a multi-pass LLM editorial pipeline (developmental → line-edit → copy-edit) with a 19-principle editorial constitution derived via Inverse Constitutional AI from 1,000 professional pairs. The question is which training or inference-time approach beyond prompt engineering best leverages 8,250 curated pairs.
